s.note: the big Thanksgiving at Danny's family home
s.how: Roast 400g diced butternut pumpkin with olive oil until soft and golden. Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast. Spread with goat's cheese, top with pumpkin and crisp sage leaves fried in oil, then drizzle with honey.

Toss 300g almonds with olive oil, chopped rosemary and smoked salt. Spread on a tray and roast at 180C for 10 minutes until fragrant. Serve warm in a bowl beside green olives, a taste of the valley the film keeps leaving and coming home to.

m.note: Marion working double shifts at the hospital
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs. Spread 300g rice in a dish, add the chicken and broccoli florets, then pour over 750ml hot stock mixed with 150ml cream. Cover and bake at 180C for 40 minutes, then top with cheddar and bake uncovered until golden.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 2 tbsp cocoa. Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 25 minutes. Cool completely, cut into squares and wrap each in paper for the stall.

d.n: Café shift brown sugar cinnamon latte
d.note: Lady Bird's job at the coffee shop
d.how: Simmer 60g brown sugar, 60ml water and a cinnamon stick for 3 minutes, then cool. Brew 4 espresso shots, or 250ml very strong coffee. Put 1 tbsp of the syrup in each of four glasses and add the coffee. Heat 600ml milk until steaming and froth it with a whisk or frother. Pour slowly over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon foam on top and dust with cinnamon.
